mapper.sql: k.*, s.name AS store_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, r.status AS return_status, o.local_status AS resend_status

FROM ecom_cs_ticket k JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = k.store_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = k.create_by LEFT JOIN ecom_return r ON r.id = k.return_id LEFT JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = k.resend_order_id
